title: Common-source splitter-ratio implication sweep
experiment_scope: EIS-derived ideal lossless two-branch model under a declared common pre-split input-field convention

source_reference.paper: Tian et al., Photonic Transformer Chip: Interference Is All You Need

convention.Ein: common optical field before the upstream I/W branch division
convention.eta: power fraction delivered to I branch
convention.branch_models: ideal lossless unitary MZI model; both output ports included in power accounting

results.off_center_ratios: Both I and W source-field comparisons mismatch at every tested eta other than 0.50.

conclusion: Within this EIS-derived model and the declared convention that Ein is the common pre-split field, eta = 0.50 is required to reproduce both Tian SI-1 S2 and S3 branch fields. Total power is conserved at all tested ratios.
limitations: This result does not establish the fabricated upstream splitter ratio.
This result does not resolve the exact physical reference planes or normalization of Ein in Tian SI-1.
This result is not a physical measurement, foundry-PDK result, EM/FDTD qualification, or formal Lean proof.
The 50:50 internal MZI couplers are distinct from the upstream I/W branch splitter.
